explication: KOReader is a portable document viewer, principally taking a reader from choosing a local document through format-specific opening to an interactive, customizable reading experience. The map also preserves documented format conversion, library/content integrations, plugins, and device portability. Paths and capabilities are grounded in the tree and README; unsampled implementation details are represented at directory level, and only high-level workflow links are asserted where source excerpts were unavailable.
